notes.title: Etched Memories Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It has been a while so we would like to give a small progress update. Some of the things we have been working on are: new maps, new movement/controls, enemies/combat, overall story, and lots of puns. We would like to thank you for being patient with us--it is hard to move fast as a two-person team. We don't want to show too many spoilers, but here is a short video demonstrating a small chunk of what we have done. Thanks for your support!

Etched Memories Team

[previewyoutube=MGT-csBkYf8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch Update v5: Gamepad Support and Audio Settings
notes.notes:
Added controller support
-may require selecting "Default" controls in the Settings menu.

Audio settings
-can be adjusted with sliders in the Settings menu.
-copyrighted music can be disabled.

Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Patch Update v4: Bug Fixes and Barrel Roll
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Gravity scale set to 1 for those who changed it while it was active in our settings.
-Can now alter mouse sensitivity using the Sensitivity slider in the Input Settings.
-Camera rotation no longer stutters when moving quickly.
-Cannot open inventory at the vent.
-Cannot use the collar on the boat.

Changes:
-Added barrel roll. To use, press "shift" while strafing.
-Mouse sensitivity lowered.
-Camera tutorial is longer.
-Added tutorial for running.

notes.title: Patch Update v3: Movement and Optimization
notes.notes:
-Revamped third person movement
-Optimized fur, cabin, and forest

[u]Please start a new game to see all the changes[/u]

Random thinking:
-Does not happen in collar cutscene
-Is less frequent

-Catnip fully heals

notes.title: Patch Update v2: Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Optimization:
-Large increase to performance / FPS

Fixed the following bugs:
-Picked up documents no longer collide with Biscuit
-Bag audio does not continue after the bag has been grabbed
-Head no longer disappears when near window in first person
-Removed VR push from program
-Pedal Boat doc changed to correct url

Improved:
-Rain particles
-Game menu
-Mouse cursor

Other changes:
-In first person, "A" and "D" strafe
-Third person view in boat defaults to further away
-In game "Exit" button goes to the Title screen instead of closing the application
-Lowered heartbeat volume

notes.title: Patch Update v1: Added Settings (Mainly graphics settings)
notes.notes:
We have added optimization settings to address performance concerns. We will go through this more thoroughly when we can, but we just wanted to make sure everyone can at least play :)

Additionally, players can now exit the boat by pressing the space bar.
